notes.title: Save Horses & Explore New Pasture Features in the Horse Designer
notes.content:
WHAT'S NEW?


Save Your Creations – You can now save the horses you create!
View & Capture – Check out your saved horses in the pasture and take beautiful screenshots, whether in the editor or out in the field.
More Variety – A wide range of new markings and coat variations are now available to make your horses truly unique.
Revamped UI – The entire user interface has been redesigned for a smoother experience.
Pasture Music Player – Enjoy a small built-in music player while spending time with your horses on the pasture.
Updated Tack Options – Tack previews have been reworked.
Improved Animations – Horse animations have been polished and enhanced for more realism.
Polished Horse Look – The overall appearance of the horses has been refined and improved.
New Game Design – A fresh game logo and updated design give the game a brand-new look.

notes.title: Unbridled: That Horse Game – Early Access is now available!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302360/68dc931c515d8c8a442ca498fb044a4d521dcc70.png

The wait is over! Unbridled: That Horse Game is now available in Early Access on Steam!

>> GET IT HERE <<


Join the Community and Shape the Game
Your feedback is important! By participating in Early Access, you have the opportunity to shape the future of Unbridled: That Horse Game. We’d love to hear your thoughts about gameplay, new features, and overall experience.

Don’t forget to drop by our Discord server to connect with other players and share your input directly with our development team.
Join our Discord using this link: https://discord.gg/2wdqQPZ5Ny

____________________________________________________________

Stay Updated
We’ll be rolling out regular updates to refine gameplay and add exciting new features. Keep an eye on Steam or Patreon for updates and patch notes! 

____________________________________________________________


Share Your Journey
We’d love to see your adventures in Unbridled! Share your favorite moments, videos, screenshots, and tips on social media using the hashtags #UnbridledThatHorseGame and #UTHG. Your posts can help grow our amazing community and inspire new players to join the journey.

notes.title: Unbridled: That Horse Game Early Access Launch Date Revealed! 🎇
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302360/027a45c5fa67649f3a2ac2b77c0a02fd57ae3ef5.png

We’re happy to announce that Unbridled: That Horse Game will launch in Early Access on February 19th, 2025!

Here’s what you need to know leading up to the big day: 
🌟 You can still claim Closed Beta Keys until January 26th, 2025. (Click here for more info)
🌟 Closed Beta Keys will be deactivated on February 10th, 2025.
🌟 All Patreon supporters who contributed up to 50€ will receive their Full Game Keys via email on February 18th, 2025, thank you for your support!
🌟 The Early Access price will be 23,99€! 

>>> WISHLIST THE GAME HERE <<<

We wish you all a Happy New Year! Thank you for being part of this journey, 2025 is going to be amazing! 🎇
